items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the direct image on presheaves attached to a functor of categories is right adjoint to the inverse image, with the displayed bifunctorial bijection (statement lines 4359-4369). The proof offers two complete routes: one reproduces the argument of the companion adjunction and identifies the map playing the role of the unit (proof lines 4372-4376); the other views presheaves of sets as presheaves with values in the opposite category, checks that the two functors are interchanged and applies the companion adjunction for such presheaves (proof lines 4379-4388). The non-formal content is the translation to the opposite category in the second route. The claim is H1: two short routes, each written out.
